newsitem.title: UK: UK's Securicor reorganises key divisions.
newsitem.headline: UK's Securicor reorganises key divisions.

text.p: Britain's Securicor Group Plc on Tuesday announced a group restructuring to give greater focus to the group's core activities of security, distribution and communications.

"I believe that our restructured business will have every opportunity of outperforming, both in terms of turnover and profit, the achievements of the past decade," said group chief executive Roger Wiggs.
Tne main element of the changes is to concentrate the various businesses into no more than three or four main sectors within each division.

In Distribution, Pat Howes becomes executive chairman. He will be supported by Richard Benson, chief executive of Securicor Omega Express and Alan Hines as managing director of Securicor Vehicle Services.

Henry McKay becomes executive chairman of Securicor Security Services. Ed Hough will remain as chief executive of the Communications division, which will concentrate on radio networks and systems worldwide.
Wiggs noted that total group turnover had jumped from 446 million pounds in 1988, his first year in charge, to 1.25 billion in 1996.
